project_type: Full-stack web application - Python FastAPI backend + React TypeScript frontend
build_system: npm/vite for frontend, pip/uvicorn for backend, Docker for containerization
test_framework: pytest for backend, vitest for frontend
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
test_command: cd backend && pytest tests/ -v && cd ../frontend && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps and run pytest. 2. Install frontend deps and run npm run build. 3. Docker build to validate full stack.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Alembic migration files in backend/alembic/versions/ - generated via 'alembic revision --autogenerate'
setup_instructions: 1. export PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15. 2. cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. 3. cd frontend && npm install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Docker available. Python 3.11 via pyenv. Node 22 available. No PostgreSQL server running locally - use SQLite for dev/testing.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines. Will establish conventions.
key_patterns: Monorepo structure: /backend (FastAPI) + /frontend (React+Vite). REST API with JWT auth. SQLAlchemy ORM with Alembic migrations. Role-based access control. Audit logging on all mutations.
directory_structure: Monorepo: backend/ (FastAPI app with app/, alembic/, tests/), frontend/ (React+Vite with src/pages, src/components, src/hooks, src/lib), docker-compose.yml at root
